limitations: TTC only; other operators are not integrated.
Scheduled counts are not real-time arrivals, observed reliability, walking access or a guarantee of accessibility.
Counts at neighbouring stops may include the same trip; do not sum them as unique vehicles.
Stops and route associations describe the feed period; hourly counts apply to the selected date and local hour.
method: Straight-line stop proximity in EPSG:26917. Hourly counts of published regular-pickup stop-time rows, including after-midnight service-day times. Supplied intermediate times are retained; missing times are not interpolated.
